decklist.description: Decklist - Catalan MTG Legacy leagues, tournaments, players and cards
decklist.text-description: Print your deck on a tournament pdf stylesheet
decklist.Name: Name
decklist.hero_lead: Generate, validate, and export print-ready competitive Magic: The Gathering tournament registration sheets tailored for Catalan DCI, Regional, and Eternal circuits.
decklist.format_hint: Accepted formats: 4 Brainstorm or 4x Force of Will. Empty lines are ignored.
decklist.mainboard_placeholder:
Paste or type your 60-card mainboard:
4 Brainstorm
4 Ponder
4 Force of Will
4 Lightning Bolt...
decklist.sideboard_placeholder:
Paste your 15 sideboard cards:
2 Pyroblast
2 Red Elemental Blast
2 Surgical Extraction...
decklist.mainboard_note: Minimum legal deck size: 60 cards. No upper limit under MTR 6.1.
decklist.sideboard_note: Maximum legal sideboard: Exactly 0 or up to 15 cards.
decklist.mtr_intro: Deck registration sheets are legally binding tournament records upon round one commencement. In accordance with the Magic Tournament Rules (MTR Section 3.9) and Infraction Procedure Guide (IPG 3.4 - Decklist Problem):
decklist.mtr_rule_1: Spelling must clearly disambiguate between existing cards (e.g. Lightning Bolt vs Lightning Strike).
decklist.mtr_rule_2: Mainboards must contain a minimum of sixty (60) registered physical cards.
decklist.mtr_rule_3: Sideboard may contain zero (0) or up to maximum fifteen (15) cards in Constructed formats.
decklist.mtr_rule_4: Discrepancies between submitted list and physical 75 will result in a Game Loss penalty.
